notes: Pre-registered from books pass-2 audit (reports/gen7_0dte_audit.json). Refines the FROZEN 0DTE straddle (entry 09:20, 25% straddle stop, flat 15:10) with regime/VRP entry gates. The base cell is unchanged; these are SKIP filters.

Evidence motivating each gate is FENCED-only (Thursday era <= 2025-08-28). The Tuesday era (2025-09-09+) is the fresh holdout and KEEPS ACCUMULATING ~4 expiry days/month — do NOT touch it until a single gated cell is frozen, then one holdout shot on whatever Tuesday-era days exist at that time.

MANDATORY before any holdout: re-run under the 2x adversarial fill model (half-spread per leg + stop-day uplift), not the optimistic 1x mid-fill. The 1x PF 1.47 is known-optimistic; 3x nearly kills it. Report PF at 1x/2x/3x for every gated cell.

Filters (each a SKIP condition, ANDed if multiple): (a) vix_skip_tercile=low -> skip entry when India VIX at 09:20 is below the trailing-252-expiry 33rd percentile; (b) vrp_min_pctile -> skip when entry ATM straddle value as %% of spot is below this percentile of the trailing 20 expiry days.
Aronson MCP permutation test to be run on the winning cell: encode the VIX gate as one rule, test net-P&L vs the no-gate null, report honest p-value (bootstrap CIs are weak at this trade count).

evaluation.kill_criteria: net positive at 2x fills AND PF_2x >= 1.25 AND positive mid+high-VIX windows AND MCP p < 0.05 on the gate; then one holdout shot.
